race.comment: HELLO VENETA (10) is the one to beat after putting a CL1 away at Northam, winning by 2.1L. Nottle hops on board now and with another favourable set-up, she looks well placed as she looks to work through the grades. Can bring up back-to-back wins. LENDANEAR (12) is the main danger, with his CL2 win her two back carrying more weight than his last-start fourth as favourite behind Please Mizter. Recent figures stack up though and another bold showing is anticipated. MORF (2) also comes through CL2 win here, scoring by 1.6L on soft ground. Has the speed to overcome a wide alley and will be in this for a very long way. SPANGLEDSTAR (6) gets a completely different scenario today from a much better barrier and an improved effort is expected. GIBRALTAR GOLD (7) gets Chris Parnham on now and is not to be discounted coming back to a trip where she's had success previously.
